name: argo-knowledge
description: Knowledge base for Red Hat OpenShift GitOps — Argo CD and Argo Rollouts as shipped by the OpenShift GitOps operator. Use when generating, reviewing, debugging, or explaining CRDs (Application, ApplicationSet, AppProject, ArgoCD, Rollout, AnalysisTemplate, Experiment, RolloutManager, NotificationsConfiguration, NamespaceManagement, ImageUpdater), configuring notifications, image updater, sync policies, progressive delivery strategies, or designing GitOps repository patterns. Argo Workflows and Argo Events are out of scope. Also use when the user asks about Argo best practices, common mistakes, or needs to choose between Argo approaches (e.g., app-of-apps vs ApplicationSet, canary vs blue-green, directory vs branch-per-environment).
